definition: in a hard and unfriendly way
description: A small kitchen at night with orange patterned tiles, a glowing pendant lamp and snow outside the window. A young woman with her hair in a bun, in a lilac jumper, sits at a wooden table with an open pizza box. The young man opposite, seen only by his green sleeves and hand, reaches towards the last slice. She pulls the box away, closes it, hugs it to her chest and glares hard at him, then points at him. A grey cat sits on the counter behind her, and glasses of water and napkins lie on the table.

de.answer: Sie drückt den Pizzakarton an ihre Brust.
de.question: Was hält die Frau?

es.answer: Está apretando la caja de pizza contra el pecho.
